title: Edge Case & Nuance Anticipation
description: Real-world systems have edge cases that break naive algorithms. Think deeply about multiple stints at the same company, varying user tenure types, dual platform states, and subtle interaction traps.
ai_training_notes: Avoid simplistic equality checks. Design composite keys and multi-attribute checks that represent reality (e.g. Company + Role + Tenure Years).
satisfaction_driver: User expects deep, proactive thinking that catches edge cases before they cause production failures.
